title: Compare retained states under their original bases
statement: The MOD-005 responsibility shall compare retained states under their original bases within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Selected retained-state comparison can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.
what.desired_outcome: Compare retained states under their original bases.

why.rationale: SR-021 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests selected retained-state comparison.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Selected retained-state comparison. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Bind both baseline identities, exact content and original rules to the selected comparison and match entities by stable identity; rename/move does not invent an addition.
Expose before/after changes in definitions, relationships, lifecycle, names/locations, governing rules and relevant provenance without rewriting either state.
Claim additions/removals only with complete relevant membership; ambiguity or unavailable interpretation remains explicit instead of unchanged or absent.
Bound no-recorded-difference to inspected content and scope; do not infer semantic equivalence, approval or satisfaction.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
